name: cloud_cover_albedo_cavity
description: Issue #100: §21's snow-cloud cavity reading §22's continuous cloud-cover fraction instead of §13's discrete classifier while curWeather == Clear. Fixed snow depth 1 (fresh) at latitude 45, hour 2 -- a genuinely dark hour (sun_elevation ~-19deg, surveyed offline) so the A/B is read on the night floor glow (NightRadiance.FloorGlowFor, the one consumer of the one-arg SurfaceBuildup.CavityGainFor(Map) this fix touches) rather than daytime dimming, which the two-arg overload (unchanged by this fix) already owns. Day 52 was picked over day 40 after a moon-phase survey: the night floor is starlight+airglow+moonlight (NightRadiance.cs), so a near-full moon (moon_illumination ~0.99, above the horizon) gives the cavity's multiplier more absolute glow to amplify than a dim/new-moon night does -- day 40 at the same hour measured a true but imperceptible median CIELAB dE of 0.83; day 52 (same tile, same snow, same hour, moon phase the only deliberate change) measures 1.12, crossing the repo's 'visible on close inspection' floor. cloud_cover off first establishes the true-no-op baseline (cavity_gain must read the exact same value it did before #100 -- the discrete Clear reading of 0 -- see CelestialLightingFeatures' own note on what 'off' must reproduce); cloud_cover on then shows the cavity tracking the continuous fraction (0.3556) instead of staying flat.
